goal: migrate.py converts a v1 device config JSON to v2. v1 has {host, user_name} and OPTIONAL port (default 443) and OPTIONAL tls (default false). v2 must be {version: 2, endpoint: {host, port}, user, tls}. The current code crashes when port is absent and wrongly defaults tls to true. Fix migrate.py so the conversion is correct, and make it idempotent: migrating an already-v2 config must leave it unchanged.
